sees: frame 1: Two gray suited older men on a light panel labeled INSIGHT 2/2 BUFFETT. The left one has a yellow circle around him and looks wide-eyed and neutral. The right one is gray, wearing glasses and frowning. A green curved arrow runs from the left man over to the right man. Between them is a green gavel-like object broken by a white zigzag line, with the word RULES in green below.

frame 2: Same layout. The right man has now turned color, with skin tone and a navy suit, still frowning. The gavel and RULES have turned gray and white. The left man stays gray inside the yellow circle.
frame 3: Same as frame 2. The right man is in full color (navy suit, frowning, glasses). The left man is gray in the circle. The broken gavel and RULES are gray.
changed: The right frowning man went from gray to full color, and the gavel and RULES label went from green to gray.
cause: Unclear. The arrow suggests something passes from the left man toward the right man, and the broken gavel marked RULES sits between them.
effect: The right man is highlighted as the focus, angry or disapproving, while the left man and the rules stay muted. It may mean the rules are broken or ignored and a disapproving figure results.
message: Buffett seems to be saying that breaking or ignoring the rules has the left man's actions drawing disapproval from the other man.
wouldConfuse: It is unclear who is who and what the arrow means. The broken gavel could mean rules are broken, ignored or ineffective. The color change is not clearly tied to any cause.
